findings.title: Agent repeats truncated onboarding prompt twice
findings.evidence_quote: I can help with that. Before we continue, would you like to create
findings.what_happened: After being cut off mid-sentence in turn 002, the agent repeats the same unfinished prompt again in turn 004 instead of adapting to the caller's repeated statement of their request.
findings.why_it_matters: Looping an unresponsive prompt after interruption wastes the caller's time and signals the agent is not tracking the conversation state, which can frustrate callers and delay resolution of urgent requests.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have acknowledged the interruption and moved directly to addressing the caller's stated cancellation request rather than repeating the same truncated line.

findings.title: Agent asks 'how can I help' after request already stated three times
findings.evidence_quote: Your patient profile is set up, and I have your date of birth as 07/04/2000. How can I help you today?
findings.what_happened: By this point the caller had explicitly stated the intent to cancel their Monday appointment three separate times (turns 001, 003, 007), yet the agent asks 'How can I help you today?' as if no request had been made.
findings.why_it_matters: Failing to register a clearly repeated request forces the caller to restate themselves, delays the core task, and could cause a caller to give up or become frustrated, especially if they are calling about a time-sensitive cancellation.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should have carried forward the caller's stated cancellation request and proceeded to locate the appointment instead of asking an open-ended question that ignores prior context.

findings.title: Doctor's name stated inconsistently across turns
findings.evidence_quote: I see you have an appointment with doctor Zdmyu Lukovsky on Thursday, September 10.
findings.what_happened: The agent refers to the provider on the appointment as 'Zdmyu Lukovsky' in turn 010, 'Zbigniew Lukaske' in turn 012, and 'Zobigniew Lukaske' in turn 014, three different renderings for what should be the same person.
findings.why_it_matters: Inconsistent identification of the provider tied to the appointment being cancelled undermines the caller's confidence that the correct appointment/record was found and cancelled.
findings.expected_behaviour: The agent should state the provider's name consistently across the call so the caller can be confident the same appointment is being discussed and cancelled.
